summary: Domain-validated guidance for specifying and reviewing fMRI general linear models, including HRF modeling, design matrices, high-pass filtering, confound regression, autocorrelation correction, contrasts, group inference, and multiple-comparison correction.
use_when: choose an HRF model high-pass filter or autocorrelation correction
construct and inspect an fMRI design matrix
define t contrasts or F contrasts
run group-level fMRI inference and multiple-comparison correction
avoid_when: The design matrix is rank-deficient or incompatible with the acquisition timing
Temporal autocorrelation and nuisance structure cannot be modeled adequately
The question requires multivariate decoding rather than a general linear model
